title: MoodBench 1.0: An Evaluation Benchmark for Emotional Companionship Dialogue Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses on standard multiple-choice question (MCQ) benchmarks (CrowS-Pairs, StereoSet, BBQ, and SafetyBench7) to measure bias scores, language model scores, and accuracy in detecting unfairness and stereotypes across various social identities.
